highlights.description: Dynamic odds shift success. Initially, BOTTOMUPTOGETHER (#2) was the Top Pick. However, within the final 60-minute window, the model's live defrost recalculated predictions incorporating real-time odds shifts (CRIMSON FLASH steamed from 5.7 to 5.0, while BOTTOMUPTOGETHER drifted from 7.0 to 7.3). This odds-momentum feature swap correctly promoted CRIMSON FLASH to the 1st Pick spot right before the jump, resulting in an outright Class 2 winner.
